comment: No source is published; read from the maker's manual. The expander check message reads 'Place to the right of TrackModule or TrackModuleExpander for this module to work.' The four shift inputs have no plain range field because their scaling is chosen on the menu: CustomBtnAndTrig::process multiplies the voltage by 1, 0.5 or 12 and clamps the step count to 10, 5 or 120. Version 2.0.2 of the plugin swapped the panel labels of the up and down inputs; in this build the down input is on the left and the up input on the right, which is what the census positions show.
